workflow: A container update obtains a non-owning reference to an existing value.
The update invokes user-controlled arithmetic that can re-enter and mutate or clear the container.
The mutation releases the value while the update still retains its non-owning reference.
The update later uses the released value, causing a use-after-free and process-terminating memory failure.
summary: Reentrant container mutation invalidates a borrowed value reference
